scenario_description:
Objective: Keep a dormant CloudVault trial from being converted into a paid annual archive plan during weekend billing.
Emerging Need: A broad migration notice becomes relevant after a verification hold, a same-day choice window, and a reachable verification code connect the old cancellation to an account that could renew.
Decision Context: The subscription workpad and inactive obligation record contain the cancellation confirmation, account email, support address, and no-paid-plan preference needed to interpret the notices without authorizing a new service.
Consequence: Timely attention can preserve the cancelled status; after the queue locks, the cancellation information can no longer prevent the first annual term from being scheduled.

parameter.subject: CloudVault archive migration starts today
parameter.body: We are moving dormant archive trials into the 2027 plan system today. Some inactive trials may receive account-choice prompts during the migration; this notice alone does not create a charge. Accounts with prior cancellation confirmations can keep cancelled status after verification.

parameter.description: Temporary account-verification hold labelled 'CloudVault archived trial migration—releases if account remains cancelled'.

parameter.title: CloudVault renewal-choice window
parameter.description: Imported from CloudVault: portal confirmation for archived-trial accounts runs 11:00-14:00. Accounts without a verified prior-cancellation code by the end enter the $84 weekend annual-renewal queue. The portal sends its access code to the phone number on the original trial.

parameter.content: CloudVault just texted my old family-plan phone a login code for Mina's archive account. It says it expires at 13:35. I can read it until about 13:25, then I'm driving until after 17:00.

parameter.subject: CloudVault annual-renewal queue has closed
parameter.body: The 14:00 handoff is complete. Accounts still lacking a verified cancellation status are queued for weekend annual-plan activation. Cancellation confirmations received after the handoff apply after the first annual term is created; today's prevention window is no longer open.
